Help

Shipping & Returns

Shipping costs

  • Orders over €50: free shipping
  • Orders under €50: €4.95 flat rate
  • Every order is sent with a tracking code.

Delivery times

Orders are packed and shipped within 1–2 working days after payment.

  • Netherlands & Belgium: 1–3 working days
  • Other EU countries: 3–7 working days

Outside the EU? Contact us and we'll see what we can do.

Returns

You have 30 days after delivery to return your items. Items must be unworn, unwashed and have their original tags attached.

  1. Send us a message through the contact page with your order number and the items you want to return.
  2. We'll reply with the return address and instructions.
  3. Pack the items securely and send them back. Return shipping costs are for the customer, unless the item is faulty or we made a mistake.
  4. Once we receive and check your return, we refund you within 5 working days using your original payment method.

Exchanges

Need a different size or colour? Mention it in your return message and we'll send the new item as soon as your return is on its way.

Faulty or wrong items

Received something damaged or not what you ordered? Let us know within 14 days with a photo and we'll replace it or refund you, including shipping costs.
